facts.fact: TelQuel reported that Morocco's draft 2027 finance bill gives the ministry for artificial intelligence, digital transformation and administrative reform a budget of MAD 1.34 billion, of which MAD 1.08 billion is investment.
facts.system: Ministry of AI, Digital Transformation and Administrative Reform 2027 budget

MAR.note: The prior-year budget is not given, so no rise or fall is stated.
